executable.title: Region of Interest Rulers
executable.description: Measure every named region in a label map: add the long-axis and short-axis rulers a region does not already have, check the rulers that are there against the segment names, and return a downloadable CSV of the measurements and any problem found.

parameters.label: Input and output
parameters.description: Annotated volume, its regions, and the generated measurements.

image.name: inputVolume
image.label: Input Volume
image.description: Volume the regions were painted on. Declared so the generated rulers come back onto it; no pixels are read from it.

image.name: inputLabelmap
image.label: Input Label Map
image.description: A scalar integer label map. Zero is background and each nonzero value is one region of interest. Embedded .seg.nrrd segment names are the region names the rulers are labeled with.

file.name: outputAnnotations
file.label: Output Annotations
file.description: One long-axis and one short-axis ruler for each region that did not already have them. Regions whose rulers exist are left alone.

file.name: outputReport
file.label: Region of Interest Report
file.description: CSV report with one row per region of interest, carrying its two measurements, segmented volume, and any problem detected.

parameters.label: Existing annotations
parameters.description: The rulers already on the image, which this task checks and preserves.

file.name: inputAnnotations
file.label: Input Annotations
file.description: Rulers already placed on the input volume. Optional: VolView binds this input only once the image has a finished annotation, and regions with no rulers yet are this task's starting case.

parameters.label: Girder API
parameters.description: Server access injected by slicer_cli_web; not shown to users.
